page.overview:
Who is Characters crossing the Forsaken?

This is a cross-reference for the main characters of the Light who directly encounter the Forsaken.

This list is not meant to be an exhaustive summary of every character who encounters a Forsaken, especially one in disguise; what is interesting instead is how many did or did not deal with them directly. Thus with the exception of one 'minor' character who fought (and defeated) one of the Forsaken, these characters are pulled from the Main/More menus at the top of this wiki.

(A blank cell means the lack of interaction has not yet been verified.)

Add † after the interaction to indicate they killed the Forsaken in their final encounter.
